name: Atonia: The Holy Church of Ascension
source:
The game begins when the player and his girlfriend have decided to migrate to a bigger and safer city to start a family. The city is deeply religious, and catches the young couple off guard. What ensues will bring them both spiraling down an endless abyss...

[From [url=https://www.patreon.com/posts/what-is-atonia-63186755]Patreon[/url]]
translation:
故事开始时，你与女友决定搬到一座更大、更安全的城市，组建家庭。然而，这座城市浓厚的宗教氛围，让这对年轻情侣措手不及。此后发生的一切，将使两人不断坠入无尽的深渊……

[摘自[url=https://www.patreon.com/posts/what-is-atonia-63186755]Patreon[/url]]
